title: Kitchen Line Clash
style: Pop-rock with upbeat midtempo bounce, tight syncopated drums, chunky muted guitar and handclap accents; verses trade coach-to-coach tension in close-mic dual lead, pre-chorus opens with rising gang oohs, chorus slams into a chantable call-and-response hook. Add tape-stop hits before key turns, whistle pops between lines, and a bright slapback delay on the hook. Crisp, punchy mix with stadium-ready vocal stacks.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You say, “Drive it deep”
I say, “Keep it soft”
You want a big first swing
I want the net to rot

Your footwork screams “go”
Mine says “hold that line”
Same court, same student
But we don’t share the sign

[Pre-Chorus]
You point at the target
I point at the gap
You chase the highlight
I trap it in the trap

You say, “Hit through”
I say, “Reset”
We’re staring at the same ball
From opposite nets

[Chorus]
We do not agree
Not on one thing
You call it attack
I call it the clean thing

We do not agree
But the kid still learns
One coach says “fire”
One coach says “turn”

We do not agree
No, not today
Same little green court
Two different ways

[Verse 2]
You want loud forehands
I want quiet hands
You chase the winner
I chase the plan

You draw a straight line
I curve the play
You love the big moment
I love the middle of the day

They ask who’s right
We both just grin
Then the ball drops short
And the lesson sinks in

[Pre-Chorus]
You point at the target
I point at the gap
You chase the highlight
I trap it in the trap

You say, “Hit through”
I say, “Reset”
We’re staring at the same ball
From opposite nets

[Chorus]
We do not agree
Not on one thing
You call it attack
I call it the clean thing

We do not agree
But the kid still learns
One coach says “fire”
One coach says “turn”

We do not agree
No, not today
Same little green court
Two different ways

[Bridge]
You want the sprint
I want the pause
You want applause
I want the cause

Maybe that’s why
The players improve
One set of eyes
Two kinds of moves

[Final Chorus]
We do not agree
Not on one thing
You call it attack
I call it the clean thing

We do not agree
But the kid still learns
One coach says “fire”
One coach says “turn”

We do not agree
Still, look what they found
Two sharp voices
One better ground
